diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["▶ On-demand (run in Agents)"] --> THEMES["🔥 Scan daily market themes"]
  THEMES --> CAND["🎯 Pick 3-5 thematic candidates"]
  CAND --> ADD["➕ Add to watchlist\nsource = llm_theme (AI Scout)"]
  ADD --> EXPIRE["⏳ 7-day expiry"]
  ADD --> RESEARCH["➡️ Enters daily ResearchAgent scoring"]

TRIG.label: On-demand
TRIG.description: Runs manually from the Agents page (not a scheduled cron). Uses deepseek-chat.
TRIG.addReason: Thematic discovery is exploratory — run when you want fresh ideas.

THEMES.label: Scan market themes
THEMES.description: Identifies the day's dominant market themes (e.g. AI infrastructure, energy, semis) from market context.
THEMES.addReason: Themes surface names the static watchlist would miss.

CAND.label: 3-5 candidates
CAND.description: Selects 3-5 thematic tickers to track — a bounded set to avoid watchlist bloat.

ADD.label: Add to watchlist (AI Scout)
ADD.description: Inserts into the watchlist with source=llm_theme, tagged 'AI Scout' and grouped under the theme name.
ADD.addReason: Auto-populates the watchlist with themed ideas.

EXPIRE.label: 7-day expiry
EXPIRE.description: AI-Scout additions expire after 7 days unless they prove out — keeps the list fresh.
EXPIRE.addReason: Themes rotate; stale ones should drop off.

RESEARCH.label: Enters research
RESEARCH.description: Once on the watchlist (research-enabled), the names flow into the daily ResearchAgent scoring like any other symbol.
RESEARCH.addReason: No special path — scored the same way.
